name: The Erawan Group Public Company Limited
summary: The Erawan Group Public Company Limited engages in hotel, and building rental and management businesses primarily in Thailand, Japan, and Philippines. The company operates hotels and resorts under the Grand Hyatt Erawan Bangkok, IBIS, JW Marriott Bangkok, The Naka Island, Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok, Holiday Inn Pattaya, IBIS Styles, Novotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 4, Holiday Inn Cebu City, Mercure Hotels, and HOP INN names. It also rents commercial retail property under the name Erawan Bangkok, as well as a shopping plaza and one office building.
